question: How many Articles were there in the original Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**395.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Originally,** the constitution adopted on November** **26, 1949,** **contained a Preamble**, 395 articles in 22 parts, and 8 schedules.**
 
• Also, the constitution now has** 25 parts and 12 schedules.**
